page.layout: Running head at top, with page number 30 at left. Below it, two circular medallion woodcuts side by side, each with a legend around its edge. Below them, one column of running text in two paragraphs. A decorative ornament sits at the foot. No notes in the margins.

main_text.p: DIONYSIVS cognominatus Liber pater, deinde Bac-chus,filius fuit Iovis ex Semele, Dionysius ab Iove & Nysa di-ctus : Nysa autem antrum est in quo à Nymphis nutritus dici-tur. Liber pater dictus est,vel à libertate patriæ, quâ armis etiâ tutatus est,vel quòd vinum,cuius inventor extitit, reddat lin-guas liberas ac faciles. Bacchus dictus est, vel à Bacchantibus mulieribus quæ ipsum sequebatur,vel à baccis, quas in torcu-lari premere docuit. Hic quorum regio vites ferre non posset, docuit potum ex hordeo conficere. In Bœotia iussit,in gratiam patriæ,omnes vrbes liberas esse. Exercitum virorum & mulie-rum circunducens, nefarios homines merita multavit pœna. In Indiam transcendit, ac militavit, anno mundi 2508. ante Christum natum 1454. triennio post,in Bœotiam multis cum spoliis rediit. Consule Diodorum Siculum de fab.antiq.gestis lib.5.

DIONYSIVS alter longè illo antiquior, ac ævo prior, à nonnullis Sebasis dictus,filius dicitur Iovis & Proserpinæ: primus hic boves sub iugum misisse fertur ad colendam terram: quare illum cornibus finxerunt. Videto Diodorum Siculum libro quo supra.

page.notes: The two medallions are woodcuts with legends: left "BACCHVS." with a "D" at the left edge; right "DIONISIVS LIB. PAT." Printed text in the medallion legends is transcribed above. The decorative ornament at the foot of the page is not text and is not transcribed. The printed "2 5 o 8" and "1 4 5 4" are copied as spaced numerals and set as 2508 and 1454; the "o" in 2508 may be an old-style zero. Printed "lib.5." may read as lib.5 in old-style figures.
